Alger, 5 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 5, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mobile operator Djezzy recorded business growth during the first three quarters of 2026. The company posted an increase in revenue as well as a rise in its subscriber base and mobile data consumption.
L'opérateur Djezzy a publié ses résultat: Operator Djezzy published its financial results for the first nine months of 2026. Revenue stands at 95.5 billion dinars, marking an 8.6% increase compared to the same period in 2025. EBITDA reached 39.9 billion dinars, reflecting the company's operational performance.
La base clients de l'opérateur a égaleme: The operator's customer base also grew to reach 18.5 million subscribers at the end of September 2026, representing a 3.6% annual increase. This momentum is supported by a 20.3% rise in average mobile data consumption over the period.
Le directeur général de Djezzy, Boumedie: Djezzy's CEO, Boumediene Senouci, emphasized the continuation of network investments. The current strategy focuses on the deployment of 5G technology and the improvement of the quality of service offered to users.
L'opérateur prévoit de continuer à enric: The operator plans to continue enriching its portfolio of technological solutions to meet customer expectations and support the evolution of digital usage in the Algerian market.
